notes.title: Devlog Patch Update for Not It: Spookiest Edition
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We've made a small patch to [i]Not It: Spookiest Edition[/i] as we come up on the first year anniversary! These patches are to fix some issues we found.

A few things we've fixed:
-Fixed a bug with incorrect sprites display
-Fixed a bug with incorrect name displayed typos
-Fixed a bug when clicking to progress wasn't working
-Removed the animated logo that is displayed after every ending (the logo will only show once when the game starts)
-Removed the gore setting that displayed after every ending (you can find it in the settings menu)

If you run into any problems with the patch or come across any additional bugs, let us know!

Thank you!

notes.title: Not It: Spookiest Edition Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone~

We've put out a small patch to [i]Not It: Spookiest Edition[/i]! Learn about what we've fixed/updated:

[list]
[*]Joseph will be more active during one of the action sequences.
[*]Joseph won't exist in two places at once after hiding in the closet (otherwise known as "Ghost Joseph.")
[*]There was one line where the cast was unexpectedly silent but that is no longer the case.
[*]Katie's new haircut is now on display in one of the ending artworks (it will remain unlocked if you unlocked it previously).
[*]Some players using newer Mac computers (M1/Apple Silicone) were having issues launching the game. This has been fixed.
[/list]
